storage: volume JSONL <archive>/vessel_identity/registry.jsonl (single append-only file, NOT hour-bucketed — a slowly-changing identity table, not a position firehose; deduped in-process so only a genuinely new (mmsi, imo) pairing is ever appended)
written_by: server/vesselIdentity.ts recordIdentityObservation, called from server/routes.ts's ShipStaticData handler
source: aisstream.io websocket ShipStaticData messages (ImoNumber/CallSign/Name fields, previously parsed nowhere — GIP BUILD QUEUE item 3, research/open_questions.md ~line 4105)
license: aisstream.io free API terms (same as vessels.json)

field_map.t: unix sec UTC — first time this exact (mmsi, imo) pair was observed
field_map.imo: IMO number (checksum-validated per IMO Res. A.600(15) before being recorded — invalid/absent IMOs are never written)
field_map.name: as-broadcast vessel name at time of observation, optional

confidence_model: IMO is a hull-lifetime identifier (unlike MMSI, which can be legally reflagged or illegally spoofed); a checksum-valid IMO co-occurring with >=2 distinct MMSIs in this registry is the published GFW/Park et al. 2023 hull-identity-change signal — a RAW observed fact from our own archive, not an interpreted shadow-fleet claim (ladder gate 1 still open, see open_questions.md)
entity_key: imo (grouping key for reuse detection); mmsi (per-observation key)
cadence: event-driven — one new line per newly-observed (mmsi, imo) pair, not per message; registry stays trivially small indefinitely by construction
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04): dataset-level manifest; datum-level fields where information varies per record. Companion to vessels.json — same source stream, different message type (ShipStaticData vs PositionReport), no position fields since ShipStaticData carries none.
